description: Rajasthan has launched its Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Policy 2026 at the Regional AI Impact Conference 2026, held alongside Rajasthan DigiFest X TiE Global Summit 2026. The policy aims to align the state with national digital priorities and accelerate technology-led growth.
body_lead: - Rajasthan has introduced a comprehensive AI/ML Policy to accelerate digital transformation - Upcoming employment policy will integrate AI to support job creation - Strong digital infrastructure and investor-friendly policies underpin Rajasthan’s tech ambitions Rajasthan has launched its Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Policy 2026 at the Regional AI Impact Conference 2026, held alongside Rajasthan DigiFest X TiE Global Summit 2026. The policy aims to align the state with national digital priorities and accelerate technology-led growth.
